title: Archive through December 19, 2002 - Anonymous (Sunday, October 13, 2002 - 03:07 pm)
content: When I was 12 I fell approximately 20-25 feet from a tree. The second I let go of the branch I blacked out. The next thing I recall I'm standing on a ladder going up. I looked above me and I saw a faceless being looking down at me. There was a bright, goldish/yellow light behind him, so maybe that's why it was faceless. I heard my sister calling my name from below me, but don't remember seeing her. I may have. I then looked over to my right and I saw my sister and my dad attempting to pull my body up the hill towards home. My sister was holding my hands and my dad my feet. I then heard a voice in my head say "You can go or you can stay". I was in no way ready to die, so I thought, "I want to stay". The next thing I know I was floating over my body looking down from behind my sister. I saw my dad attempting to go to his left, so they could pull me up the hill side ways but she told him to just hold my feet. I didn't hear her literally, just they were communicating. I then started to sink back into my body. I was told that they walked me around the house, but I don't remember any of that. I woke up in the ambulance and saw the male nurse at my feet; I was really dizzy and just messed up, so I went back to sleep. I didn't wake up again until in the hospital bed a few hours later.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Standing on a ladder going up; later floating over the body looking down from behind sister.

arrival.other_being_detail: A faceless being looking down; bright goldish/yellow light behind him (possibly why faceless).

environment.environment_other_detail: Bright, goldish/yellow light behind the faceless being; otherwise described as being on a ladder going up.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell approximately 20-25 feet from a tree at age 12.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial blackout; 'standing on a ladder going up'; faceless being with bright gold/yellow light; heard sister calling; observed sister and dad pulling body; telepathic message: 'You can go or you can stay'; chose to stay; floating over body; sank back into body; later woke in ambulance then hospital.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackout followed by being on a ladder going up (not a tunnel), encounter with faceless being/light, then observation of physical scene and choice to return, then re-entry.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience began with 'standing on a ladder going up' after blacking out; faceless being with bright goldish/yellow light behind him.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "You can go or you can stay"; "I want to stay".
